title: Elon Musk ne abhi ek car ko UDA diya.
content:
Elon Musk ne abhi ek car ko UDA diya.

Drone nahi. Concept video nahi.
Asli Tesla Roadster... LIVE, Texas mein, crowd ke saamne.

Ye dekho.

Car ek bade curved ramp pe chadhti hai...
aur chadhti rehti hai... jab tak wo ULTA latak nahi jaati.

Kaise?
Neeche SpaceX ke saath bana ek FAN system hai...
jo car ko 2G force se track pe chipka ke rakhta hai.

Phir wo chhod deti hai.
Hawa mein FLIP maarti hai...
aur crash hone ki jagah... dheere se HOVER karke neeche aati hai.

Ye CGI nahi hai.
Ye hain COLD-GAS THRUSTERS...
wahi tech jo SpaceX rockets mein use karta hai.

Tesla ke engineering VP Lars Moravy ne bataya...
car mein 10 THRUSTERS hain, aur 600 LITRE compressed air.

Aur yahin nahi ruke.

Roadster ne Tesla ki poori lineup ke upar se JUMP maara...
Model 3, Model Y, Cybertruck, Semi aur Cybercab.
Hawa mein... ek "KICKFLIP".

Musk ne kaha... ye "kisi bhi JAMES BOND car se better hai."
Aur ye bhi kaha...
"Success guaranteed nahi hai... par excitement 100 PERCENT guaranteed hai."

Ab asli baat.

Jo version sach mein jump aur hover karta hai...
uska naam hai ROCKET.
Single seat. Invite-only.
Aur normal roads ke liye approved nahi hai.

Production 2028 mein plan hai.

Toh ye cars ka FUTURE hai...
ya Tesla ka ab tak ka sabse bada STUNT SHOW?

Comment mein batao.
Aur follow karo... next video mein dikhaunga
ye car 0 se 60 sirf 0.81 SECOND mein kaise jaati hai.
